data.one_liner: Shows a loading overlay that auto‑hides when async work completes.
data.what_it_does: The package displays a modal overlay with a spinner, optional message and progress. It automatically cleans up when the wrapped async operation finishes, supports concurrent tasks, and blocks interaction for accessibility.
use_when: During a single async operation that needs a visual cue
When multiple async tasks run concurrently and you want the overlay to stay until all finish
When you need an app‑wide or route‑level loading guard
When you want a fully accessible, reduced‑motion‑friendly loading UI
avoid_when: When you require a custom Material/Cupertino spinner without providing a custom builder
When you need to integrate with a global state manager that already handles loading states
weaknesses: Breaking changes in 0.7.0 (default indicator, interaction blocking)
Requires manual controller for advanced use
No built‑in Material/Cupertino spinners after breaking change
data.minimal_example:
```dart
LoadingOverlay(
  isLoading: isSaving,
  message: 'Saving…',
  child: yourPage,
)
```
